sloth - A small command-line 3D renderer

A simple command-line 3D renderer that can render Wavefront OBJ models to the terminal or export
static images and lightweight web-friendly renders.

Demo and examples
-----------------
- Demo (interactive example): http://ecumene.xyz/sloth-demo

Quick usage
-----------
Render a model to the terminal or to an image file. Replace <args> with the model(s) and options.

Render Pikachu to the terminal:

  sloth models/Pikachu.obj

Render multiple models:

  sloth "models/suzy.obj models/suzy.obj"

Generate a static image (specify width/height):

  sloth models/Pikachu.obj image -w <width_in_pixels> -h <height_in_pixels>

Export a portable web-friendly render (JSON/JS data):

  sloth models/Pikachu.obj image -j <number_of_frames> -w <width_in_pixels> -h <height_in_pixels> > src-webify/data.js

import subprocess, re
r=subprocess.run(["./executable","assets/test_model.obj","image","-w","10","-h","5"],capture_output=True,text=True)
s=r.stdout
print("total",len(s))
# tokens
# pattern per piece
pat=re.compile(r'\x1b\[48;2;(\d+);(\d+);(\d+)m\x1b\[38;2;(\d+);(\d+);(\d+)m(.*?)\x1b\[49m\x1b\[39m',re.S)
ms=list(pat.finditer(s))
print("matches",len(ms))
pos=0
for i,m in enumerate(ms):
    if m.start()!=pos:
        print("gap at",i,pos,m.start(),repr(s[pos:m.start()]))
    pos=m.end()
    txt=m.group(7)
    if txt not in (' ', '#','@','%','*','+','=','-',':','.'):
        print(i, m.groups(), repr(txt))
print("end pos",pos,"tail",repr(s[pos:]))
# list content lengths
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(repr(m.group(7)) for m in ms))

import os, pty, sys, time, select, fcntl, termios, struct, signal
args=sys.argv[1:]
# last special env? args for executable after -- ; duration first arg, keys second
dur=float(args[0]); keys=args[1].encode().decode('unicode_escape').encode() if len(args)>1 else b''
cmd=args[2:]
pid, fd = pty.fork()
if pid==0:
    os.execv(cmd[0], cmd)
else:
    # set winsize 80x24
    fcntl.ioctl(fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack('HHHH',24,80,0,0))
    out=b''
    start=time.time(); sent=False
    while time.time()-start<dur:
        r,_,_=select.select([fd],[],[],0.05)
        if fd in r:
            try:
                data=os.read(fd,65536)
            except OSError:
                break
            if not data: break
            out+=data
        if not sent and time.time()-start>dur-0.3 and keys:
            os.write(fd,keys); sent=True
    # try q then kill
    try: os.write(fd,b'q')
    except: pass
    time.sleep(0.3)
    # drain
    while True:
        r,_,_=select.select([fd],[],[],0.1)
        if fd not in r: break
        try:
            d=os.read(fd,65536)
        except: break
        if not d: break
        out+=d
    try:
        wpid,status=os.waitpid(pid,os.WNOHANG)
        print("wait",wpid,status, file=sys.stderr)
        if wpid==0:
            os.kill(pid,signal.SIGKILL); os.waitpid(pid,0); print("killed",file=sys.stderr)
    except Exception as e: print("waiterr",e,file=sys.stderr)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(out)
PY

import subprocess
def show(name,verts,w=60,h=30):
    txt=''.join(f'v {x} {y} {z}\n' for x,y,z in verts)+'f 1 2 3\n'
    p=f'/tmp/m/{name}.obj';open(p,'w').write(txt)
    r=subprocess.run(["./executable","-b",p,"image","-w",str(w),"-h",str(h)],capture_output=True,text=True)
    s=r.stdout[:-1]
    pts=[(i%w,i//w,c) for i,c in enumerate(s) if c not in(' ','\n')]
    nl=sorted(set(i//w for i,c in enumerate(s) if c=='\n'))
    print(name,verts,"nlrows",nl,"pts bbox", (min(x for x,y,c in pts),max(x for x,y,c in pts),min(y for x,y,c in pts),max(y for x,y,c in pts)) if pts else None,"chars",set(c for x,y,c in pts))
    ss=s.replace('\n','N')
    for y in range(h):

def one(verts,faces,w=100,h=50):
    txt=''.join(f'v {a} {b} {c}\n' for a,b,c in verts)
    txt+=''.join('f '+' '.join(str(i) for i in f)+'\n' for f in faces)

    pts=[(i%w,i//w) for i,c in enumerate(s) if c not in(' ',NL)]
    return pts
# square at z, no ref (ref in square itself max=1); identify missing pixels by compare z0 set
def square(z):
    verts=[(0,0,z),(1,0,z),(1,1,z),(0,1,z)]
    return set(one(verts,[(1,2,3,4)]))
base=square(0)
for z in [0.44,0.45,0.5,0.75,1]:
    s=square(z)
    print("z",z,"n",len(s),"missing bbox",end=' ')
    miss=base-s; extra=s-base
    if miss: print("miss x",min(x for x,y in miss),max(x for x,y in miss),"y",min(y for x,y in miss),max(y for x,y in miss), "extra",len(extra))
    else: print("none extra",len(extra))
# Triangle (0,0),(1,0),(0,1) at z
def tri(z):
    return set(one([(0,0,z),(1,0,z),(0,1,z)],[(1,2,3)]))
base=tri(0)
for z in [0.3,0.44,0.45,0.5,1]:
    s=tri(z); miss=base-s
    print("tri z",z,"n",len(s),"miss",len(miss), "extra",len(s-base), "miss sample",sorted(miss)[:10])

    for yy in [1,5,10,15,20,24]:
        xs=[x for x,y in s if y==yy]
        x0=[x for x,y in base if y==yy]
        print(" y",yy,"base", (min(x0),max(x0)) if x0 else None,"now",(min(xs),max(xs)) if xs else None)

import subprocess, random, math
NL='\n'
W=80; H=40
random.seed(1)
tris=[]
for i in range(12):
    pts=[]
    for j in range(3):
        pts.append((random.uniform(-0.8,0.9),random.uniform(-0.8,0.9),0.0))
    # ensure winding positive normal z (cross z >0 in world xy): (b-a)x(c-a) z >0
    (ax,ay,_),(bx,by,_),(cx,cy,_)=pts
    if (bx-ax)*(cy-ay)-(by-ay)*(cx-ax)<0:
        pts[1],pts[2]=pts[2],pts[1]
    tris.append(pts)
def ref(pts):
    txt=''.join(f'v {x} {y} {z}\n' for x,y,z in pts)+'f 1 2 3\n'
    open('/tmp/m/fit.obj','w').write(txt)
    r=subprocess.run(["./executable","-b","/tmp/m/fit.obj","image","-w",str(W),"-h",str(H)],capture_output=True,text=True)
    s=r.stdout[:-1]
    return set((i%W,i//W) for i,c in enumerate(s) if c not in(' ',NL))
refs=[ref(t) for t in tris]
for i,t in enumerate(tris):
    print(i,t,len(refs[i]))
# candidate functions
def simulate(pts, mode):
    # normalization max signed among all coords init0
    M=0.0
    for p in pts:
        for v in p: M=max(M,v)
    pts=[tuple(v/M for v in p) for p in pts]
    S=min(W,2*H)
    scale_x=S/2; scale_y=S/4
    # mode offsets/casts stored tuple
    ox,oy,cast,loopincl,bboxclamp = mode
    raw=[]
    for x,y,z in pts:
        sx=-x*scale_x + W/2 + ox
        sy=-y*scale_y + H/2 + oy
        raw.append((sx,sy))
    if cast=='int':
        sp=[(int(x),int(y)) for x,y in raw] # trunc toward zero
    elif cast=='round':
        sp=[(round(x),round(y)) for x,y in raw]
    else:
        sp=raw
    xs=[p[0] for p in sp]; ys=[p[1] for p in sp]
    xmin=int(min(xs)); xmax=int(max(xs)); ymin=int(min(ys)); ymax=int(max(ys))
    if bboxclamp:
        xmin=max(xmin,0); ymin=max(ymin,0); xmax=min(xmax,W-1); ymax=min(ymax,H-1)
    xend=xmax+1 if loopincl else xmax
    yend=ymax+1 if loopincl else ymax
    out=set()
    (ax,ay),(bx,by),(cx,cy)=sp
    # barycentric edge functions (float)
    denom=(by-cy)*(ax-cx)+(cx-bx)*(ay-cy)
    if denom==0: return out
    for yy in range(ymin,yend):
        for xx in range(xmin,xend):
            l1=((by-cy)*(xx-cx)+(cx-bx)*(yy-cy))/denom
            l2=((cy-ay)*(xx-cx)+(ax-cx)*(yy-cy))/denom
            l3=1-l1-l2
            if l1<0 or l2<0 or l3<0: continue
            out.add((xx,yy))
    # newline overwrite at x=1 for bbox rows ymin..yend (approx remove x=1 in those rows)
    out={(x,y) for x,y in out if not (x==1 and ymin<=y<yend)}
    return out
modes=[]
for ox in [0,1,0.5]:
 for oy in [0,1,0.5,-0.5]:
  for cast in ['int','float','round']:
   for loopincl in [True,False]:
    for clamp in [True,False]:
        modes.append((ox,oy,cast,loopincl,clamp))
results=[]
for mode in modes:
    totaldiff=0; exact=0
    for t,r in zip(tris,refs):
        s=simulate(t,mode)
        d=len(s^r); totaldiff+=d
        if d==0: exact+=1
    results.append((totaldiff,exact,mode))
results.sort()
for r in results[:20]: print(r)

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp'); from safe import run_ref
import re
W=80;H=40
r=run_ref(["/tmp/m/t.obj","image","-w",str(W),"-h",str(H)])
pat=re.compile(r'\x1b\[48;2;(\d+);(\d+);(\d+)m\x1b\[38;2;(\d+);(\d+);(\d+)m(.*?)\x1b\[49m\x1b\[39m',re.S)
ms=list(pat.finditer(r.stdout))
print("cells",len(ms))
from collections import Counter
print(Counter((m.group(4),m.group(5),m.group(6),m.group(7)) for m in ms))
# positions where fg != black or char != space
pts=[]
for i,m in enumerate(ms):
    if (m.group(4),m.group(5),m.group(6))!=( '0','0','0') or m.group(7) not in(' ','\n'):
        pts.append((i%W,i//W,m.group(7),m.groups()[3:6]))
print("nonblack/nonspace",len(pts),pts[:20])

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp'); from safe import run_ref
import re
W=80;H=40
# big square centered using tri_mtl red so fg 255,0,0
open('/tmp/m/bigsq.obj','w').write('mtllib tri.mtl\nv -0.8 -0.8 0\nv 0.8 -0.8 0\nv 0.8 0.8 0\nv -0.8 0.8 0\nusemtl Red\nf 1 2 3 4\n')
# tri.mtl is in /tmp/m, obj there yes
r=run_ref(["/tmp/m/bigsq.obj","image","-w",str(W),"-h",str(H)])
pat=re.compile(r'\x1b\[48;2;(\d+);(\d+);(\d+)m\x1b\[38;2;(\d+);(\d+);(\d+)m(.*?)\x1b\[49m\x1b\[39m',re.S)
ms=list(pat.finditer(r.stdout))
from collections import Counter
print(Counter((m.group(4),m.group(7)) for m in ms))
for y in range(H):
    row=''
    for x in range(W):
        m=ms[y*W+x]
        if (m.group(4),m.group(5),m.group(6))==('0','0','0'): row+=' '
        else: row+=m.group(7) if m.group(7)!=' ' else '.'
    if row.strip(): print(y,row.rstrip())

pat=re.compile(r'\x1b\[48;2;(\d+);(\d+);(\d+)m\x1b\[38;2;(\d+);(\d+);(\d+)m(.*?)\x1b\[49m\x1b\[39m',re.S)
W=80;H=40

r=run_ref(["/tmp/m/mix.obj","image","-w",str(W),"-h",str(H)])
ms=list(pat.finditer(r.stdout))
sp=[(-x*40+41,-y*20+20) for x,y in pts]
(ax,ay),(bx,by),(cx,cy)=sp; den=(by-cy)*(ax-cx)+(cx-bx)*(ay-cy)
data=[]
for i,m in enumerate(ms):
    if m.groups()[3:6]==('0','0','0'): continue
    sx,sy=i%W,i//W
    la=((by-cy)*(sx-cx)+(cx-bx)*(sy-cy))/den; lb=((cy-ay)*(sx-cx)+(ax-cx)*(sy-cy))/den; lc=1-la-lb
    wx=la*pts[0][0]+lb*pts[1][0]+lc*pts[2][0]; wy=la*pts[0][1]+lb*pts[1][1]+lc*pts[2][1]
    data.append((sx,sy,m.group(7)=='@',la,lb,lc,wx,wy))
candidates={
 'la':lambda d:d[3],'lb':lambda d:d[4],'lc':lambda d:d[5],'wx':lambda d:d[6],'wy':lambda d:d[7],
 'wx+wy':lambda d:d[6]+d[7],'wx-wy':lambda d:d[6]-d[7],'r':lambda d:math.hypot(d[6],d[7]),
 'sx':lambda d:d[0],'sy':lambda d:d[1],'sx+2sy':lambda d:d[0]+2*d[1],'sx-2sy':lambda d:d[0]-2*d[1],
 '2sx+sy':lambda d:2*d[0]+d[1],
}

    vals=sorted(data,key=lambda d:f(d))
    seq=''.join('1' if d[2] else '0' for d in vals)
    # number of runs and best threshold accuracy
    runs=1+sum(seq[i]!=seq[i-1] for i in range(1,len(seq)))
    # interval accuracy: @ if in [lo,hi] best via brute over sorted unique? just report runs and first/last
    print(name,"runs",runs,"seq",seq[:120])

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp'); from safe import run_ref
import re
pat=re.compile(r'\x1b\[48;2;(\d+);(\d+);(\d+)m\x1b\[38;2;(\d+);(\d+);(\d+)m(.*?)\x1b\[49m\x1b\[39m',re.S)
W=80;H=40
tri=[(1, -0.27676103539298547, 0), (0.20389315584894296, 0.716334307931209, 0), (0.12336471778799785, -0.1653112405587518, 0)]
def render(d,order='tri_first'):
    sq=[(-0.9,-0.9,d),(0.9,-0.9,d),(0.9,0.9,d),(-0.9,0.9,d)]
    txt='mtllib depth.mtl\n'
    verts=tri+sq
    txt+=''.join(f'v {x} {y} {z}\n' for x,y,z in verts)
    if order=='tri_first': txt+='usemtl Green\nf 1 2 3\nusemtl Red\nf 4 5 6 7\n'
    else: txt+='usemtl Red\nf 4 5 6 7\nusemtl Green\nf 1 2 3\n'
    open('/tmp/m/overlap.obj','w').write(txt)
    r=run_ref(["/tmp/m/overlap.obj","image","-w",str(W),"-h",str(H)])
    ms=list(pat.finditer(r.stdout))
    # count within tri geometric area approx: use tri alone drawn mask from a separate render? Simplify: count red vs green total
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter()
    for m in ms:
        fg=m.groups()[3:6]
        if fg==('255','0','0'): cnt['R']+=1
        elif fg==('0','255','0'): cnt['G']+=1
    print("d",d,order,cnt)
for d in [-0.5,-0.1,-0.01,0,0.01,0.1,0.5]:
    render(d); render(d,'sq_first')

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
exec(open('/tmp/fitcov.py').read().split("best=[]")[0])
import math
def scan_int(pts,ox,oy,cast,incl):
    raw=[(-x*40+40+ox,-y*20+20+oy) for x,y,z in pts]
    if cast=='int': t=[(int(a),int(b)) for a,b in raw]
    elif cast=='round': t=[(round(a),round(b)) for a,b in raw]
    else: t=[(math.floor(a),math.floor(b)) for a,b in raw]
    t=sorted(t,key=lambda p:p[1])
    (x0,y0),(x1,y1),(x2,y2)=t
    out=set(); total=y2-y0
    if total==0: return out
    for i in range(total+1 if incl else total):
        second = i>(y1-y0) or y1==y0
        seg=(y2-y1) if second else (y1-y0)
        if seg==0: continue
        alpha=i/total
        beta=(i-((y1-y0) if second else 0))/seg
        Ax=x0+(x2-x0)*alpha
        Bx=(x1+(x2-x1)*beta) if second else (x0+(x1-x0)*beta)
        if Ax>Bx: Ax,Bx=Bx,Ax
        for xx in range(int(Ax),int(Bx)+1):
            if 0<=xx<W and 0<=y0+i<H: out.add((xx,y0+i))
    return out
best=[]
for ox in [0,1]:
 for oy in [0,1]:
  for cast in ['int','round','floor']:
   for incl in [True,False]:
    tot=sum(len(scan_int(t,ox,oy,cast,incl)^r) for t,r in zip(tris,refs))
    best.append((tot,ox,oy,cast,incl))
best.sort(); print(best[:10])
# also barycentric with int points but float P and cross method (already tested via s1r =402)

W=200;H=100
def cube_obj(cx,cy,cz,s=0.04):
    corners=[(cx+dx,cy+dy,cz+dz) for dx in(-s,s) for dy in(-s,s) for dz in(-s,s)]
    # corners index: 0:--- 1:--+ 2:-+- 3:-++ 4:+-- 5:+-+ 6:++- 7:+++
    faces=[(0,1,3,2),(4,6,7,5),(0,4,5,1),(2,3,7,6),(0,2,6,4),(1,5,7,3)]
    txt=''.join(f'v {x} {y} {z}\n' for x,y,z in corners)
    txt+='v 1 0 0\nv 1 0 0\nv 1 0 0\n'
    for f in faces: txt+='f '+' '.join(str(i+1) for i in f)+'\n'
    txt+='f 9 10 11\n'
    return txt
def centroid(P,args):
    open('/tmp/m/cubeprobe.obj','w').write(cube_obj(*P))
    r=run_ref(["/tmp/m/cubeprobe.obj","image","-w",str(W),"-h",str(H)]+args)
    ms=list(pat.finditer(r.stdout))
    pts=[(i%W,i//W) for i,m in enumerate(ms) if m.groups()[3:6]!=('0','0','0')]
    if not pts: return None
    xs=[p[0] for p in pts]; ys=[p[1] for p in pts]
    # screen to world x',y': sx = W/2 - x'* (S/2), S=min(W,2H)=200 -> slope100; sy=H/2 - y'*50
    cx=sum(xs)/len(xs); cy=sum(ys)/len(ys)
    return (round((W/2-cx)/100,3),round((H/2-cy)/50,3),len(pts),(min(xs),max(xs),min(ys),max(ys)))
for P in [(0.7,0,0),(0,0.7,0),(0,0,0.7)]:
    print("P",P,"no rot",centroid(P,[]))
    for axis in ['x','y','z']:

import os, sys, time, select, fcntl, termios, struct, subprocess
cols=int(sys.argv[1]); rows=int(sys.argv[2]); dur=float(sys.argv[3]); cmd=sys.argv[4:]
master, slave = os.openpty()

start=time.time()
p=subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdin=slave, stdout=slave, stderr=slave, close_fds=True)
os.close(slave)
os.set_blocking(master, False)
buf=b''; events=[]
while time.time()-start<dur:
    r,_,_=select.select([master],[],[],0.01)
    if master in r:
        try: d=os.read(master,65536)
        except OSError: break
        if not d: break
        buf+=d
        # split frames as they complete (next goto seen)
        while buf.count(b'\x1b[1;1H')>=2:
            idx=buf.find(b'\x1b[1;1H',1)
            frame=buf[:idx]; buf=buf[idx:]
            events.append((time.time()-start,frame))
    if p.poll() is not None: break
try: os.write(master,b'q')
except: pass
try: p.wait(timeout=1)
except: p.kill(); p.wait()
print("frames captured",len(events),file=sys.stderr)

    body=f.split(b'\x1b[1;1H',1)[-1]

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp'); from safe import run_ref
def t(name,verts):
    open('/tmp/m/min0.obj','w').write(''.join(f'v {x} {y} {z}\n' for x,y,z in verts)+'f 1 2 3\n')
    print(name,run_ref(["-b","/tmp/m/min0.obj","image","-w","0","-h","0"]).returncode)
t("orig y .5, M=.5, norm y=1",[(0,0,0),(0.25,0,0),(0,0.5,0)])
t("orig y .5, M=.25, norm y=2",[(0,0,0),(0.25,0,0),(0,0.5,0),(0,0,0)])
# make M small via all coords small but y=0.5 is max -> norm 1. To get norm y=2 need another vertex with negative large? M is signed max; norm y>1 impossible for the max vertex; but a *different* vertex can have norm y<1 while orig y>1 if M from x. Already tested.
# What about orig y>1 in an STL file at 0x0?
open('/tmp/m/y1.stl','w').write("solid t\n facet normal 0 0 1\n  outer loop\n   vertex 0 0 0\n   vertex 1 0 0\n   vertex 0 2 0\n  endloop\n endfacet\nendsolid t\n")
print("stl y=2",run_ref(["-b","/tmp/m/y1.stl","image","-w","0","-h","0"]).returncode)
# y>1 with rotation applied in image mode -x 1 (rotates y into z) - does original y still trigger?
open('/tmp/m/min0.obj','w').write("v 0 0 0\nv 1 0 0\nv 0 2 0\nf 1 2 3\n")
print("y=2 with -x 1.57",run_ref(["-b","/tmp/m/min0.obj","image","-w","0","-h","0","-x","1.57"]).returncode)
print("y=2 with -z 1.57 (y->x)",run_ref(["-b","/tmp/m/min0.obj","image","-w","0","-h","0","--roll=1.57"]).returncode)
PY
"}

    ms=list(pat.finditer(r.stdout))

    rows=sorted(set(p[1] for p in P)); cols=sorted(set(p[0] for p in P))
    print(name,"rows",(rows[0],rows[-1]) if rows else None,"cols",(cols[0],cols[-1]) if cols else None,"n",len(P))

For interior row0 need sy<0: rotate quad slightly? Use -z rotation to tilt a big square so part goes above: easier - big square [-1,1] rotated -z 0.5: corners y' up to 1.4 -> sy negative at top corner.

    P=[(i%W,i//W) for i,m in enumerate(ms) if m.groups()[3:6]!=('0','0','0')]
    rows=sorted(set(p[1] for p in P))

import subprocess, re, math
def load_stl_ascii(path):
    tris=[]; verts=[]
    for line in open(path):
        t=line.split()
        if not t: continue
        if t[0]=='vertex': verts.append(tuple(float(x) for x in t[1:4]))
        if t[0]=='endfacet':
            if len(verts)==3: tris.append(tuple(verts))
            verts=[]
    return tris
tris=load_stl_ascii('assets/part.stl')
print("faces",len(tris))
# normalization M global max signed
M=0.0
for tri in tris:
    for p in tri:
        for v in p: M=max(M,v)
print("M",M)
pat=re.compile(rb'\x1b\[48;2;(\d+);(\d+);(\d+)m\x1b\[38;2;(\d+);(\d+);(\d+)m(.*?)\x1b\[49m\x1b\[39m',re.S)
W,H=60,30
r=subprocess.run(["timeout","-s","KILL","3","/tmp/refbin/executable","assets/part.stl","image","-w",str(W),"-h",str(H)],capture_output=True)
ms=list(pat.finditer(r.stdout))
S=min(W,2*H)
def screen(p):
    return (W/2-(p[0]/M)*(S/2), H/2-(p[1]/M)*(S/4))
# for each face, take centroid screen, sample virtual pixel (even x), get ref char, compute world nz
def cross(a,b): return (a[1]*b[2]-a[2]*b[1],a[2]*b[0]-a[0]*b[2],a[0]*b[1]-a[1]*b[0])
mismatch=0; total=0
examples=[]
for tri in tris:
    a,b,c=[tuple(v/M for v in p) for p in tri]
    e1=tuple(b[i]-a[i] for i in range(3)); e2=tuple(c[i]-a[i] for i in range(3))
    n=cross(e1,e2); l=math.sqrt(sum(v*v for v in n))
    if l==0: continue
    nz=n[2]/l
    if nz<=0: continue
    cen=tuple((a[i]+b[i]+c[i])/3 for i in range(3))
    sx,sy=screen(cen)
    vx=int(math.floor(sx/2)); y=int(math.floor(sy))
    if not (1<=vx<W-1 and 1<=y<H-1): continue
    idx=y*W+2*vx
    if idx>=len(ms): continue
    refch=ms[idx].group(7).decode()
    if ms[idx].groups()[3:6]==(b'0',b'0',b'0'): continue
    palette=" .:-=+*#%@"
    pred=palette[min(9,int(nz*10))]
    total+=1
    if refch!=pred:
        mismatch+=1
        if len(examples)<15: examples.append((nz,pred,refch,(round(n[0]/l,3),round(n[1]/l,3),round(nz,3))))
print("checked",total,"mismatch",mismatch)
for e in examples: print(e)

fn write_err(e: io::Error) -> DynError {
    Box::new(IoError(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Other, e)))
}

fn generate_image(
    inputs: &Inputs,
    width: usize,
    height: usize,
    rotation: (f32, f32, f32),
    frames: Option<i32>,
) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::fmt::Debug>> {
    match frames {
        None => {
            let mut rast = Rasterizer::new(width, height, inputs.color);
            rast.draw_model(&inputs.model.triangles, rotation, inputs.scale);
            if inputs.color {
                let stdout = io::stdout();
                let mut lock = stdout.lock();
                lock.write_all(rast.render_color().as_bytes()).map_err(write_err)?;
                lock.flush().map_err(write_err)?;
            } else {
                println!("{}", rast.render_plain());
            }
        }
        Some(frame_count) => {
            println!("let frames = [");
            let step = (2.0 * std::f32::consts::PI) / frame_count as f32;
            let total: usize = if frame_count == 0 { 1 } else { frame_count as usize };
            let mut angle = 0.0f32;
            for i in 0..total {
                let mut rast = Rasterizer::new(width, height, inputs.color);
                let rot = (rotation.0, rotation.1 + angle, rotation.2);
                rast.draw_model(&inputs.model.triangles, rot, inputs.scale);
                print!("`\n");
                if inputs.color {
                    print!("{}", rast.render_web());
                } else {
                    println!("{}", rast.render_plain());
                }
                angle += step;
                if i + 1 == total {
                    print!("`];\n");
                } else {
                    print!("`,\n");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
